title: Creamy cheddar potato bake
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original food illustration for a recipe card. Subject: Creamy cheddar potato bake. Ingredient reference: Potato, Heavy cream, Cheddar cheese, Onion, Milk, Butter. Preparation reference: One batch makes 4 portions. Preparation: 15 minutes; cooking: 65 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 5 minutes. Heat the oven to 180 C conventional and butter a 25 cm shallow baking dish. Peel the potato and slice 3 mm thick; peel and thinly slice the onion. Grate the cheddar cheese. Layer the potato and onion in the dish, scattering half the cheese between the layers. Mix the heavy cream and milk and pour over. Cover the dish with foil and bake for 40 minutes. Remove the foil, add the remaining cheese and bake for 20 minutes more, until the potatoes are easily pierced with a knife and the top is golden. Rest for 5 minutes before serving..
